links.outcome: Output variability of GPT-4.0 across five repeated identical runs, by data element
links.effect: Response variability ranged from 0.14% to 3.61%, differed by data element (P < .001), and was inversely correlated with accuracy (P < .001).
links.quote: Response variability over five repeated runs ranged from 0.14% to 3.61%, differed based on the data element extracted (P < .001), and was inversely correlated with accuracy (P < .001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and reproducibility/variability of an enterprise GPT-4 pipeline for structured data extraction from unstructured prostate MRI radiology reports against human abstraction.
